sections.A: Patellar tendon chapni ke neeche wale siray ko pindli ki haddi se jorta hai. Jumper's knee mein yeh tendon load se dard karta hai, khaas kar kudne wale khilariyon mein.
sections.B: Chapni ke bilkul neeche ek jagah dard, jo load (kudna, squat) shuru karne par aata hai aur load ke saath barhta hai.
sections.C: Kya ek ungli se dard ki jagah dikha sakte hain, aur kudne ya training ka load haal mein barha ya nahi.
sections.D: Sujan aur muscles dekhein, chapni ka neeche wala sira dabayein, aur single-leg decline squat.
sections.E: Chapni ke neeche wale siray ko dabana aur decline squat; dard load ke saath barhna tendinopathy ka nishan hai.
sections.F: Patellofemoral pain (phaila hua dard), fat pad aur Osgood-Schlatter (naujawan) isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Achanak pop aur ghutna seedha na kar sakna, gap ya chapni upar chali gayi: tendon phat gaya, urgent refer.
sections.H: Pehle rupture rule out karein. Phir chapni ke neeche local dard jo load se barhe: patellar tendinopathy.
sections.I: Quadriceps, hamstrings aur pindli par soft tissue kaam, aur chapni ki mobilisation.
sections.J: Dheere dheere barhta tendon load pehli line hai: isometric, phir heavy slow, phir energy storage (kudna), phir khel.
sections.K: Barf aur TENS optional; lambe dard mein shockwave.
sections.L: Rupture screen, tendinopathy ko load ka masla samjhayein, phir staged loading program aur khel par wapsi.
sections.M: VISA-P, decline squat ya hop par dard, dabane par dard aur taaqat dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 25 saal ke volleyball player ko 4 mahine se chapni ke neeche dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: rupture rule out, phir education, load control aur dheere dheere loading.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
